# Mobile Photo Upload Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** Let the author add photos to a draft from their phone's camera roll, via a signed one-hour upload link generated by a new MCP tool, instead of needing an already-hosted photo URL.

**Architecture:** A new MCP tool (`get_photo_upload_link`) generates a signed, draft-scoped link. A new pair of plain Express routes (alongside the existing `/health`/`/callback` routes in `mcp-server/src/server.ts`) serve a small mobile upload page and accept sequential raw-byte photo uploads, storing each to R2 and appending it to the draft. All of this lives in `mcp-server/`.

**Tech Stack:** TypeScript, Express (existing app in `src/server.ts`), `@aws-sdk/client-s3` (R2), `@octokit/rest` (via existing `src/github.ts`), Zod, Vitest + `supertest`.

## Global Constraints

- New env vars `UPLOAD_LINK_SECRET` and `AUTHOR_GITHUB_TOKEN` are required at runtime (via `requireEnv`, matching the existing pattern in `src/blob.ts`) — never optional/silently-defaulted.
- Upload links are valid for exactly 1 hour (`3_600_000` ms) — not configurable per the approved spec.
- No caption field on the mobile upload page — photos are appended with `{ url }` only, matching the spec's explicit decision.
- Photos upload **sequentially** from the page's JS, one `fetch` awaited before the next starts — never in parallel — to avoid racing the draft's read-modify-write commit.
- The signed link token itself carries no GitHub credential — verification only proves "may upload to this draftId before this expiry," nothing else.
- Reuse `MAX_PHOTO_BYTES` / the `image/*` content-type check already in `src/blob.ts` — don't duplicate size/type validation logic anywhere else.

---

- `mcp-server/src/blob.ts` — `fetchAndStorePhoto(photoUrl)` validates content-type/size and uploads to R2 via `@aws-sdk/client-s3`. Has a private `requireEnv` helper.
- `mcp-server/src/drafts.ts` — `readDraft(client, 'post'|'set', id): Promise<Draft>`, `writeDraft(client, kind, id, draft, message): Promise<void>`. Drafts live on branch `draft/post-<id>` / `draft/set-<id>`.
- `mcp-server/src/github.ts` — `createGitHubClient(token: string): { octokit: Octokit }`.
- `mcp-server/src/tools/attachPhoto.ts` — existing pattern for a draft-mutating tool: read draft, check `draft.kind === 'post'`, mutate, write draft, return `{ content: [{ type: 'text' as const, text: '...' }] }`.
- `mcp-server/src/tools/index.ts` — `registerTools(server, accessToken)` calls one `registerX(server, accessToken)` per tool file.
- `mcp-server/src/server.ts` — Express app; `/health` and `/callback` show the plain-route pattern (not MCP JSON-RPC); global `app.use(express.json())` is already mounted.

```typescript
import { PutObjectCommand, S3Client } from '@aws-sdk/client-s3';

const MAX_PHOTO_BYTES = 25 * 1024 * 1024;

export function requireEnv(name: string): string {
  const value = process.env[name];
  if (!value) throw new Error(`${name} is not set`);
  return value;
}

function getR2Client(): S3Client {
  const accountId = requireEnv('R2_ACCOUNT_ID');
  return new S3Client({
    region: 'auto',
    endpoint: `https://${accountId}.r2.cloudflarestorage.com`,
    credentials: {
      accessKeyId: requireEnv('R2_ACCESS_KEY_ID'),
      secretAccessKey: requireEnv('R2_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY'),
    },
  });
}

export async function storeImageBuffer(buffer: Buffer, contentType: string): Promise<string> {
  if (!contentType.startsWith('image/')) {
    throw new Error(`Unsupported content type (expected an image, got ${contentType || 'unknown'})`);
  }
  if (buffer.byteLength > MAX_PHOTO_BYTES) {
    throw new Error(`Photo is too large (${buffer.byteLength} bytes, max ${MAX_PHOTO_BYTES})`);
  }

  const extension = contentType.split('/')[1]?.split(';')[0] ?? 'jpg';
  const key = `posts/${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8)}.${extension}`;

  await getR2Client().send(
    new PutObjectCommand({
      Bucket: requireEnv('R2_BUCKET_NAME'),
      Key: key,
      Body: buffer,
      ContentType: contentType,
    }),
  );

  return `${requireEnv('R2_PUBLIC_URL').replace(/\/$/, '')}/${key}`;
}

export async function fetchAndStorePhoto(photoUrl: string): Promise<string> {
  const response = await fetch(photoUrl);
  if (!response.ok) {
    throw new Error(`Failed to fetch photo from ${photoUrl}: ${response.status}`);
  }

  const contentType = response.headers.get('content-type') ?? '';
  const arrayBuffer = await response.arrayBuffer();
  return storeImageBuffer(Buffer.from(arrayBuffer), contentType);
}
```

- [ ] **Step 3: Implement `uploadLink.ts`**

Create `mcp-server/src/uploadLink.ts`:

```typescript
import { createHmac, timingSafeEqual } from 'node:crypto';
import { requireEnv } from './blob.js';

const DEFAULT_TTL_MS = 60 * 60 * 1000;

function computeToken(draftId: string, expiresAt: number): string {
  return createHmac('sha256', requireEnv('UPLOAD_LINK_SECRET')).update(`${draftId}.${expiresAt}`).digest('hex');
}

export function signUploadLink(draftId: string, ttlMs = DEFAULT_TTL_MS): { token: string; expiresAt: number } {
  const expiresAt = Date.now() + ttlMs;
  return { token: computeToken(draftId, expiresAt), expiresAt };
}

export function verifyUploadLink(draftId: string, expiresAt: number, token: string): boolean {
  if (!Number.isFinite(expiresAt) || expiresAt < Date.now()) return false;

  const expected = Buffer.from(computeToken(draftId, expiresAt), 'hex');
  const actual = Buffer.from(token, 'hex');
  if (expected.length !== actual.length) return false;

  return timingSafeEqual(expected, actual);
}
```

- [ ] **Step 3: Implement the tool**

Create `mcp-server/src/tools/getPhotoUploadLink.ts`:

```typescript
import { z } from 'zod';
import type { McpServer } from '@modelcontextprotocol/sdk/server/mcp.js';
import { createGitHubClient } from '../github.js';
import { readDraft } from '../drafts.js';
import { signUploadLink } from '../uploadLink.js';
import { requireEnv } from '../blob.js';

export function registerGetPhotoUploadLink(server: McpServer, accessToken: string): void {
  server.registerTool(
    'get_photo_upload_link',
    {
      title: 'Get a mobile photo upload link',
      description:
        'Generates a one-hour signed link to a mobile-friendly page for uploading photos directly from a phone camera roll, attaching them to the draft. Use this instead of attach_photo when the author wants to add a photo from their phone rather than an already-hosted URL.',
      inputSchema: {
        draftId: z.string(),
      },
    },
    async ({ draftId }) => {
      const client = createGitHubClient(accessToken);
      const draft = await readDraft(client, 'post', draftId);
      if (draft.kind !== 'post') throw new Error(`Draft ${draftId} is not a post draft`);

      const { token, expiresAt } = signUploadLink(draftId);
      const baseUrl = requireEnv('MCP_SERVER_URL').replace(/\/$/, '');
      const url = `${baseUrl}/upload/${draftId}?exp=${expiresAt}&token=${token}`;

      return {
        content: [
          {
            type: 'text' as const,
            text: `Open this link on your phone to upload photos (expires in 1 hour): ${url}`,
          },
        ],
      };
    },
  );
}
```

```typescript
  return JSON.stringify(value).replace(/</g, '\\u003c');
}

function renderUploadPage(draftId: string, exp: string, token: string): string {
  return `<!doctype html>
<html>
  <head>
    <meta charset="utf-8" />
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1" />
    <title>Upload photos</title>
    <style>
      body { font-family: sans-serif; max-width: 480px; margin: 2rem auto; padding: 0 1rem; }
      button { font-size: 1rem; padding: 0.75rem 1.5rem; margin-top: 1rem; }
      ul { list-style: none; padding: 0; }
      li { padding: 0.25rem 0; }
      .done { color: green; }
      .failed { color: red; }
    </style>
  </head>
  <body>
    <h1>Upload photos</h1>
    <input id="files" type="file" accept="image/*" multiple />
    <button id="submit">Upload</button>
    <ul id="status"></ul>
    <script>
      const draftId = ${jsonForScript(draftId)};
      const exp = ${jsonForScript(exp)};
      const token = ${jsonForScript(token)};
      document.getElementById('submit').addEventListener('click', async () => {
        const input = document.getElementById('files');
        const statusList = document.getElementById('status');
        const files = Array.from(input.files || []);
        statusList.innerHTML = '';

          item.textContent = 'Uploading ' + file.name + '...';
          statusList.appendChild(item);
          try {
            const res = await fetch('/upload/' + draftId + '/photo?exp=' + exp + '&token=' + token, {
              method: 'POST',
              headers: { 'Content-Type': file.type },
              body: file,
            });
            const data = await res.json();
            if (res.ok && data.ok) {
              item.textContent = 'Uploaded ' + file.name;
              item.className = 'done';
            } else {
              item.textContent = 'Failed: ' + file.name + ' (' + (data.error || res.status) + ')';
              item.className = 'failed';
            }
          } catch (err) {
            item.textContent = 'Failed: ' + file.name + ' (network error)';
            item.className = 'failed';
          }
        }
      });
    </script>
  </body>
</html>`;
}

function queryString(value: unknown): string {
  return typeof value === 'string' ? value : '';
}
```

Add these two routes below the existing `/callback` route (before `const authMiddleware = ...` or after — either works, but keep it grouped with the other plain routes):

```typescript
app.get('/upload/:draftId', (req, res) => {
  const { draftId } = req.params;
  const exp = Number(req.query.exp);
  const token = queryString(req.query.token);

  if (!verifyUploadLink(draftId, exp, token)) {
    res.status(403).send('This link has expired or is invalid — ask Claude for a new one.');
    return;
  }

  res.type('html').send(renderUploadPage(draftId, String(exp), token));
});

app.post('/upload/:draftId/photo', express.raw({ type: () => true, limit: '26mb' }), async (req, res) => {
  const { draftId } = req.params;
  const exp = Number(req.query.exp);
  const token = queryString(req.query.token);

  if (!verifyUploadLink(draftId, exp, token)) {
    res.status(403).json({ ok: false, error: 'Link expired or invalid' });
    return;
  }

  const contentType = req.headers['content-type'] ?? '';

  try {
    const url = await storeImageBuffer(req.body as Buffer, contentType);

    const client = createGitHubClient(requireEnv('AUTHOR_GITHUB_TOKEN'));
    const draft = await readDraft(client, 'post', draftId);
    if (draft.kind !== 'post') throw new Error(`Draft ${draftId} is not a post draft`);
    draft.photos = [...draft.photos, { url }];
    await writeDraft(client, 'post', draftId, draft, `Attach mobile-uploaded photo to draft ${draftId}`);

    res.json({ ok: true, url });
  } catch (err) {
    res.status(400).json({ ok: false, error: err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Upload failed' });
  }
});
```

In `docs/AUTHORING-SETUP.md`, within step 5's bulleted list of environment variables (right after the `R2_PUBLIC_URL` bullet), add:

```markdown
   - `UPLOAD_LINK_SECRET` — random secret used to sign/verify the one-hour mobile photo-upload links generated by the `get_photo_upload_link` tool. Generate with e.g. `openssl rand -hex 32`.
   - `AUTHOR_GITHUB_TOKEN` — a fine-grained GitHub PAT scoped to Contents read/write on this repo, used only by the `/upload/:draftId/photo` route to commit mobile-uploaded photos to a draft branch (independent of the per-session OAuth token used by MCP tool calls, since that session is long gone by the time the author opens the upload link on their phone).
```

Then add a new paragraph after the existing "Resolved — post photos no longer share the private OAuth store" paragraph (before the "Resolved — step 2's project root..." paragraph), documenting the feature itself:

```markdown
**Mobile photo upload.** Attaching a photo directly in a Claude chat doesn't work — Claude perceives an attached image through a vision encoder, not as text, so it can't pass the raw bytes as a tool argument, and MCP has no released mechanism for a tool to receive an attached file (as of writing, the closest proposal, SEP-2631, is still in draft with no client support). Instead, `get_photo_upload_link` returns a one-hour signed link to a small mobile page (`GET /upload/:draftId`); opening it on a phone and picking photos uploads them one at a time to `POST /upload/:draftId/photo`, which stores each in R2 and appends it to the draft directly — no URL needs to be pasted back into chat.
```
